descriptor.name: ANDF e-Foncier cadastral parcels — Cotonou
descriptor.scope: Verified bounded Cotonou cadastral parcel samples from the ANDF e-Foncier service. Only the configured Cotonou entry is enabled; coverage beyond the tested cells and national completeness are unverified.
descriptor.licenceNote: ANDF describes public consultation and duplication except personal or confidential information, with online/private access subject to conditions and fees. descriptor.attribution: ANDF (Agence Nationale du Domaine et du Foncier), e-Foncier cadastral parcels; adapted to WGS84. Verified Cotonou samples only.

privacy: Pass-through transport returns the original WFS Response and does not inspect, modify, or persist raw feature bodies. The adapter receives the unchanged provider response and canonical output retains configured outFields only. Saved evidence contains safe canonical IDs, counts, request metadata and bounded canonical GeoJSON; no owner, contact or other raw fields are stored.
requestPrivacyNote: The existing WFS adapter does not add a server-side propertyName selection; the provider may return additional schema fields in its response. This run leaves production requests and responses untouched and stores no raw response body or unconfigured properties. Review server-side field reduction separately if needed.

identityDiagnostics.scope: Adapter-retained unique feature IDs; raw provider rows are not persisted or inspected.
